svg.text: Say hello to Mrs. B and Curious! Color the classroom.
Hello Learners! Let's Go Further Together! ♡
1. Light Base Wash → 2. Medium Midtone → 3. Dark Shadow → 4. White Highlight
Words: teacher / pwofesè · hello / bonjou · friend / zanmi · kind / jantiy
Mrs. B tip: Mande pitit ou a: "Kiyès ki pwofesè a?" (Who is the teacher?) Practice saying "Hello, Mrs. B!" together.
